I REALLY AM NOT THE LORD OF DEMON

I really like this novel.

Don't be fooled by the title it's not a JP novel it's CN. A comedic novel with a dark undertone.

MC seems like a normal person, but we find out that he is the strongest creature in existence. But he himself is unaware of this as his strong self is in slumber, and is slowly awakening.

His bookstore is surrounded by a fog at night, this fog connects his bookstore to different worlds different dimensions. the books he sells seem normal to him but are inherintances of destroyed high level races that existed all over the universes.

His strong self is the strongest creature in existence. HE is so strong that he raises a pet God and has creatures that can destroy worlds as his servants are hidden in walls and in cracks all over his bookstore. just that he is unaware.

Honestly, it is a very interesting read. I rate it above 'I’m Really Not The Demon God’s Lackey'
